page_title: EIN 2-2 RBL | Eintracht Frankfurt v RB Leipzig 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Heel Injury

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+11' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jonathan Norbye (RB Leipzig) for Xavi Simons.
90+11' Substitution. Nuha Jatta (RB Leipzig) on for Benjamin Sesko.
90+11' The referee signals a substitution. Sebastian Rode (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Mario Gotze.
90+10' Here is a change. Fares Chaibi is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+9' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90+7' That's the end of the game for Hugo Ekitike, who is replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+7' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+6' Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
90+2' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+2' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) for a tough tackle.
90' Here comes a substitution. Amadou Haidara is given a rest as he is replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
90' Today's match ends for Benjamin Henrichs who will be replaced by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig).
80' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Buta.
78' Substitution. Ellyes Skhiri walks off the pitch and Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
78' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
77' 2 - 2 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the penalty inside the left post.
77' It’s a PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt after the VAR review!
76' Referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Eintracht Frankfurt. Let’s see what happens!
76' PENALTY APPEAL by Eintracht Frankfurt, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
74' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Eljif Elmas will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
71' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.

67' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. RB Leipzig are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
63' Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) hides his face in shame! He blows a big chance to score from the rebound and sees his shot smash against the right post!
63' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) fires in a shot from the edge of the box which deflects off one of the defending players and hits the right post!
61' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Felix Zwayer didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

60' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) alters the score to 1:2. He jumps highest near the penalty spot to meet a good cross from Ansgar Knauff and steers a header in off the right post. Janis Blaswich was helpless.
56' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
56' The match has to be interrupted due to technical problems.
51' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) sees a yellow card from Felix Zwayer after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
50' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' 0 - 2 Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball into the roof of the net in trademark fashion.
46' Referee Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.
45+2' Janis Blaswich leaps to intercept the corner kick from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt). The referee points to the corner flag and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Kevin Trapp into right side of the goal.
41' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is going to take the penalty!
40' Felix Zwayer blows for a foul after Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a penalty for RB Leipzig!
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.

35' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
34' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
31' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

23' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
22' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

21' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Janis Blaswich easily deals with the threat. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner kick.
21' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
18' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
16' Close! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.

16' That didn't go as planned! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Janis Blaswich, who easily kept it out.
11' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Fares Chaibi.
10' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
5' The corner by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
5' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Trapp intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Felix Zwayer.
